definitions.full: H1411. gedaberayya דְָֽבְרַיָּא noun masculine plural emphatic Dan 3:2-3 , dubious: most think || form of [ גַּזְבָּר ] treasurer (or, Mey Entst. J. 23 , textual error for ׳גז ); Gr Bev and others read הַדָּֽבְרַיָּא ministers ( 3:24 ); possibly (see Lag Dr and others) dittograph for following דְּתָֽבְרַיָּא .
